title: Missing AuthProvider Wrapper in Root Application
symptom: Uncaught Error: useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider when visiting /login or /signup
root_cause: AuthProvider was defined in context/AuthContext.jsx but never wrapped around routes in App.jsx
resolution: Wrapped AuthProvider around the Router and Routes in frontend/src/App.jsx

title: Protocol Explorer Missing from Sidebar Navigation
symptom: Route /protocol existed in App.jsx but was inaccessible from the primary AppLayout navigation sidebar
root_cause: NAV_ITEMS array in frontend/src/layouts/AppLayout.jsx omitted the /protocol entry
resolution: Added Protocol Explorer entry with Activity icon and 'Simulator' badge to NAV_ITEMS

title: URLSearchParams Passing Literal 'undefined' Strings to Backend Alerts API
symptom: Navigating to /threats initially displayed 0 alerts despite database containing 142 records
root_cause: Object { severity: undefined, engine: undefined } was serialized by URLSearchParams to 'severity=undefined&engine=undefined', which backend interpreted as literal search queries
resolution: Implemented _cleanParams() helper in frontend/src/services/api.js to strip undefined, null, empty string, and 'all' values prior to constructing URLSearchParams

title: AlertCard Risk Score Rendered with Duplicate Multiplication (6400%)
symptom: Risk score badge inside AlertCard component rendered 6400.0% instead of 64%
root_cause: Backend returns risk_score as an integer 0-100; AlertCard was multiplying by 100 unconditionally
resolution: Added conditional check in frontend/src/components/AlertCard.jsx: alert.risk_score > 1 ? `${alert.risk_score}%` : `${(alert.risk_score * 100).toFixed(0)}%`

title: Landing Page Primary CTA Routing to Non-Existent /app Path
symptom: 'Launch Console' button on /landing directed users to /app which triggered a fallback redirect
root_cause: Landing.jsx used legacy link '/app' from prior routing refactor
resolution: Updated CTA links in frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx to point directly to '/'

title: WebSocket Hook Initial State Asynchrony in LiveMonitor
symptom: LiveMonitor initially reported WebSocket status as 'disconnected' even when wsService was already open
root_cause: useWebSocket hook initialized status with static string 'disconnected' instead of querying wsService.getStatus()
resolution: Added getStatus() to WebSocketService and initialized useWebSocket status state with () => wsService.getStatus()

title: Detection API Inability to Run Dataset-Level Evaluation on Empty Session List
symptom: Detection API returned 0 processed sessions when invoked with empty session_ids on a valid dataset
root_cause: NetworkEvent.session_id.in_([]) evaluated to false and processing loop skipped dataset sessions
resolution: Conditionally filtered session_ids and populated target_session_ids from dataset sessions if session_ids is empty

title: Detection Lab Low-Contrast Text on Light Surfaces (WCAG AA/AAA)
symptom: Metric cards and icons in Detection Lab used text-emerald-400, text-blue-400, and text-amber-400 which washed out on white background
root_cause: Hardcoded dark-mode 400 tints without light-mode variants
resolution: Upgraded classes to responsive pairs: text-emerald-600 dark:text-emerald-400, text-blue-600 dark:text-blue-400, text-amber-600 dark:text-amber-400

title: AlertDetailResponse Missing Core Forensics Fields
symptom: GET /api/alerts/{alert_id} stripped summary, dataset_id, responsible_events, and processing_time_ms
root_cause: AlertDetailResponse Pydantic schema omitted these fields
resolution: Added dataset_id, summary, responsible_events, and processing_time_ms to AlertDetailResponse

title: TrafficSimulator Omitting Workspace Isolation Boundary
symptom: Simulated events and alerts generated by TrafficSimulator lacked workspace_id
root_cause: TrafficSimulator constructor omitted workspace_id parameter and defaulted created records to null
resolution: Passed ctx.workspace_id to TrafficSimulator and tagged created NetworkEvent and Alert records
